scenes.title: A lab's budget in a Privy server wallet
lines: Beyond login, Privy holds a robotics lab's money. The lab's budget is a Privy server wallet, under a policy with one allowed action: a transaction to Thenar's contract on Monad testnet, worth at most a tenth of a MON.

Here it posts a bounty. Privy signs, and Monad executes it and makes it final. Then the same wallet is asked to send money to another address, and Privy's policy engine refuses before a signature exists.

scenes.title: The lab's task, task 13
lines: An operator picks up the lab's task.

scenes.title: Paid from the lab's escrow
lines: And one Monad transaction records their run and pays them from the escrow the Privy wallet funded. Operators sign in with Privy too, and get paid into that wallet.

card.head: No payout key on a laptop.
card.sub: to == AxonProtocolV2 · chain 10143 · value ≤ 0.1 MON · everything else: policy_violation

lines: A lab can automate bounties, and the worst case is that it funded Thenar tasks.
